pages.name: Latvian Gambit: Mayet Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's Nxe5 in a Black plan without the ...fxe4 that precedes it; rewritten with the moves numbered. Plan 3 was generic; rewritten around the weakened light squares and d3 against the e4-pawn.

pages.name: Open Game: Gunderam Defence, 3.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote 'e7' as if it were a move; reworded. Plan 1 gained the Nd5 idea, hitting the e7-queen and c7.

pages.name: Philidor Defense: Lion Variation, Bishop Sacrifice
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 named Ng5+, Ne6 and Nxc7 without the line that makes them legal; rewritten with 6...Kxf7 7.Ng5+ Kg8 8.Ne6 Qe8 9.Nxc7 and Black's ...Qg6 counter.

pages.name: Four Knights: Rubinstein, 5.Ba4 Nxf3+
pages.notes: Plan 1 said White uses 'the two bishops' (both sides keep both bishops); plan 2's ...d5 could not be read while White is in check; rewrote both around 6.Qxf3.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Symmetrical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named a 'Rubinstein Maneuver' Nd2-f1-g3 (no such name; the rook stands on f1). Plans 1 and 2 missed that 7.Bg5 is the main move; overview, plans 1 to 3 rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Symmetrical Variation
pages.notes: After 7...Ne7 plan 1 played Bxc6 (no knight on c6) and plan 3 called ...Ne7 a pin-breaker; the overview did not describe the Pillsbury. Rewrote the overview and all four plans (Bxf6, Nh4, ...Ng6, ...c6 and ...d5).

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Symmetrical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's d4 in a Black plan and suggested ...Ne7 without its point; rewritten (...Ne7-g6, ...Ba5 or ...Bc5 against c3, ...c6 and ...d5). Overview: British spelling and what 7.Ne2 does.

pages.name: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation, Symmetrical Variation, Metger Unpin
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the knight ...Ne8-g7 (g7 holds a pawn) and missed the Metger idea, ...Nd8-e6; plan 4's 'light-square blockade' was vague. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Four Knights: 4.Bb5 Bb4 5.O-O O-O
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed the c8-bishop to e6 or g4 with the d7-pawn still blocking it; rewritten with ...d6 first. Plans 1 and 4 rewritten around 6.d3 d6 7.Bg5 and Ne2-g3. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Four Knights: Symmetrical, 7.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 said Black gets the bishop pair after ...Bxc3 (Black gives it up); plan 4 said ...Qe7 alone breaks the pin; plan 1 named bxc3 before ...Bxc3. Rewrote the overview and all four plans.
